versions.changelog:
- Added a new guardrails.db file to the project.
- This addition may provide local persistence or data support for the guardrails engine.

Initial release of the Agent Policy & Guardrails Engine skill.

- Provides a framework to build, run, and extend agent policy enforcement and guardrails logic.
- Includes FastAPI interfaces, core evaluation engine, policy parsers, schema/models, and audit logging.
- Supports diverse policy types (financial, privacy, operational, etc.) and decision outputs (`ALLOW`, `DENY`, `MODIFY`, `REQUIRE_APPROVAL`).
- Documents standard workflows, project layout, enforcement contracts, and conflict resolution rules.
- Includes seed data and test coverage for both API endpoints and policy logic.
